description: Perform a bulk import of 15 new workstation assets into ManageEngine ServiceDesk Plus using a provided CSV file. The file is located at /home/ga/Desktop/shipment_sf_2025.csv. You must navigate to the Assets module, use the Import from CSV feature, and correctly map the CSV columns to the system fields (Inventory Tag -> Asset Name, Serial Number -> Service Tag, Office -> Site, etc.). Ensure all 15 records are imported successfully.
